title: Recap: *ha … volna*, and what *lett volna* adds

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know the past counterfactual *ha … volna* and *kellett volna* from B1 Unit 20, and the ending *-hat/-het* from A2 Unit 23. A judgement about a past decision combines them with an adjective in *-ható/-hető* and *lett volna*: *Ha az orvos tájékoztatta volna a beteget, elkerülhető lett volna a baj.* New here is this formal frame, not the *volna* clause.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: A noun predicate works the same way: *kötelessége lett volna* + infinitive says that someone had a duty and did not meet it.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Ha időben beavatkoztak volna, megelőzhető lett volna a kár.
If they had intervened in time, the damage would have been preventable.
Az intézménynek kötelessége lett volna kivizsgálni az esetet.
The institution would have had the duty to investigate the case.
Visszatekintve belátható, hogy más döntést kellett volna hozni.
In retrospect it can be seen that a different decision should have been made.
